draft_reason: The optimization-only source, exact train and inner-dev commitments, trainer and analyzer bytes, and execution base commit have not all been frozen and pushed. This draft cannot authorize smoke, screen, confirmation, or any metric-producing model run.
objective: Test whether removing one or both components of the v1 double-imbalance treatment improves PsySUICIDE inner-dev accuracy while preserving prespecified macro-F1 and critical-risk recall guards.

scope.development_source: only the previously committed 9,342-row optimization partition
scope.external_claim_boundary: All v2 results are internal development evidence on a split derived from the optimization partition. They are not official-valid, official-test, frozen-holdout, cross-benchmark, clinical, deployment, significance, equivalence, or superiority evidence beyond the prespecified inner-dev comparison.

source_contract.canonical_row: UTF-8 JSON with keys idx, labels, text in that order; idx and text coerced to strings; ensure_ascii=false; separators=(',', ':')
source_contract.artifact_commitment: sha256(UTF-8 join of lexicographically sorted row digests with newline separators)
required_validation: exactly one declared label per row
artifact commitment exactly matches the required optimization commitment
no dataset-root, full-train, official-valid, official-test, or holdout path is accepted
explicitly_rejected_inputs: the 2,329-row frozen internal holdout or its membership
any dataset root from which a forbidden split could be reconstructed

label_order: 与自杀/自伤/攻击行为无关

inner_split.algorithm: Within each label, compute rank_digest=sha256(seed + NUL + row_digest), sort ascending by (rank_digest,row_digest), take the first max(1,floor(label_rows*0.20)) rows as inner-dev, and assign the remainder to train.
inner_split.commitment_algorithm: For each partition, sha256(UTF-8 join of lexicographically sorted row digests with newline separators).
inner_split.overlap_requirement: zero row-digest overlap between train and inner-dev
inner_split.freeze_requirement: The split-freeze command must verify the source contract, expected counts, whole-partition commitments, per-label inner-dev commitments, and zero overlap without emitting row content. Exact commitments and implementation SHA-256 values must replace all PENDING values in a final preregistration committed and pushed before training_allowed may become true.

fixed_training_protocol.resume_rule: resume only the latest checkpoint carrying a valid post-save completion marker whose recorded file byte counts and SHA-256 values all verify under the identical run identity; ignore partial checkpoint directories
fixed_training_protocol.best_checkpoint_identity: private complete file manifest plus aggregate-only manifest SHA-256 and model-weight SHA-256 values
fixed_training_protocol.class_weight_formula: inverse fourth-root train-class frequency, normalized to mean 1.0 and clipped to [0.35,4.0]
fixed_training_protocol.best_checkpoint_ties: on an exact unrounded accuracy tie, retain the earlier epoch; secondary metrics never select a within-run checkpoint

B.sampling: weighted replacement sampling using the fixed class-weight formula

C.loss: class-weighted focal loss using the fixed class-weight formula and gamma=1.5

D.sampling: weighted replacement sampling using the fixed class-weight formula
D.loss: class-weighted focal loss using the fixed class-weight formula and gamma=1.5

code_smoke.data: deterministic subsets drawn only from frozen train and inner-dev membership

ranking: fixed arm order A, B, C, D

confirmation.arms: the eligible non-D screen winner and D only

metric_definitions.accuracy: number of exact 11-class argmax matches divided by 1,863 inner-dev rows
metric_definitions.macro_f1: unweighted mean of one-vs-rest F1 across all 11 labels with zero_division=0
metric_definitions.weighted_f1: support-weighted mean of one-vs-rest F1 across all 11 labels with zero_division=0
metric_definitions.pooled_critical_risk_recall: sum of exact-label true positives across the six prespecified critical-risk labels divided by their summed gold support
metric_definitions.stable_per_class_guard: a prespecified critical class is individually gated only when its frozen inner-dev support is at least 10; lower-support classes are reported as sparse without stable per-class claims

screen.candidate: the top-ranked non-D arm only; if D ranks first, stop
screen.failure_action: STOP_NO_SCREEN_EVIDENCE; do not substitute the second-ranked arm or change thresholds

decision_rules.claim_limits: Passing permits only the prespecified internal inner-dev improvement statement. Failure is not equivalence. No result permits claims about official valid/test, the already-consumed frozen holdout, another dataset, static-site routing, clinical safety, or production.

paired_hierarchical_bootstrap.procedure: For each replicate, sample the three confirmation seeds with replacement. Within each sampled seed, resample paired inner-dev row positions with replacement separately inside each frozen gold-label stratum, preserving each stratum size and using identical sampled positions for candidate and D. Recompute the metric delta per sampled seed and average over the three sampled seeds. Use the 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles.

public_allowed: this preregistration and its final frozen replacement
source, train, and inner-dev cryptographic commitments
configuration, software versions, Git identities, and file hashes
negative results and declared compute blockers
private_ignored_only: row digests and row-level gold or prediction labels
logits, probabilities, calibration rows, and confusion matrices
checkpoints, weights, optimizer state, and trainer state
local absolute paths and execution receipts
